parts:
Great, Thank you for creating my beta account. I just uploads my codes and its working great, now I can show my colleagues what I did without asking them to come by my computer. One thing though, I have codes in github/gist, and can I use the shiny beta hosting server and github? for example 

http://spark.rstudio.com/antu/GLMMLM_yield/ is what I just made by copying my codes to my folder. 

and  i used to run runGitHub("shinyGLMMLM", "anantaacharya") to run in my local, would't it be great if we could do  http://spark.rstudio.com/github/anantaacharya/shinyGLMMLM and see the desired result?

Thanks

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny beta hosting and github (or gist)
parts: Git is installed on Spark. So you should be able to checkout your repo directly into the ShinyApps directory, then just do a pull whenever your repo is updated and you want to deploy.
